review_stages.name: prediction_cell_scope
review_stages.purpose: Define the population of cells for risk prediction independently of event presence.
review_stages.area_denominator: Explicitly record study-AOI intersection and mapped area; do not assume full 25 km2.

review_stages.name: candidate_local_cover_context
review_stages.purpose: Assess local cover of each retained first-detection point without inferring fire type from cell cover alone.
review_stages.multiple_first_points: Retain all point identities and conflicting evidence under their common candidate context.
